learning_outcomes.text: will have knowledge of and be able to use the most common concepts and models for how economical decisions should be made based on given information and with a view to various economical goals within consumer theory.

syllabus_topics: Building mathematical models: Formulating and solving mathematical models applied on economic problems, optimization with constraints
Theory of Producers: Production functions, iso-cost curves, expansion curves, Long-run and short-run problems, pricediscrimination, homogenous production functions
Market theory: Perfect competition, Monopoly, Monopolistic competition, dopoly, oligopoly, Cournot, Stackelberg and joint optimum solutions
Differences between business and economic approach
assessment_rules: Grades for examination modules are decided in accordance with the assessment criteria presented at the start of the course. The grading scale is U, 3, 4, 5.
bibliography: Parts of: Produktion och marknad by Robert Lundmark
degree: Industrial Engineering and Management - International (6CIEI), terms 1-6 (first cycle)
